schema_note: The second shape: a STANDING council. Same vocabulary as quick-council.json; the differences are what the book says differ between standing and special committees [50:3, 50:7-9, 50:29]. Only fields that differ from quick-council.json carry comments.
kind_cite: 50:7 — constituted to perform a continuing function; 50:8 — standing authority to act, or automatic referral of a class of business, requires constitution by bylaw or by a resolution that is a special rule of order (notice + two-thirds, or majority of the entire membership) in the PARENT; for a steward-parent that is the steward's act

standing_authority.class_of_business: decisions in the ASF in-place refactor where the right answer depends on which part of the system the decider knows best (specimens-2026-11-03.md)
standing_authority.may_originate_cite: 50:8 first bullet — only by the parent's special-rule-grade act, which this charter is
standing_authority.may_act_cite: 50:4-5 — 'with power' must be given expressly; absent it the council only reports

authority.parent_powers: as quick-council.json, plus: refer new matters at any time [50:19 'at any time if it is a standing committee']; instruct that the 49:21 informalities not apply [50:26]

roll.desc: DECLARED. A standing roll is seats with a term; 'the members of the old committee continue their duties until their successors are chosen' [50:29]. Seat identity is member identity across sittings even though each sitting's occupant is a fresh fork.

term.ends: DECLARED: on the parent's act, or at a named event (e.g. the refactor's close)
term.partial_replacement: a seat re-assigned to a different SOURCE (not a re-fork of the same source) is a term boundary for that seat: clock.term_boundary_before_next_session = true

seats.perspective: correctness of what main holds; re-derives
vsect: what the trail can and cannot say
the loop's dynamics: who checks whom, continuity vs independence

officers.chair_cite: 13:18 — a committee named by a power that did not designate a chair elects its own; until then the first-named seat calls it together and presides pro tem. With a member-chair the sua-sponte duties return [39, 43, 50:25 n7] and the chair participates fully [49:21(7)].

quorum.cite: 40:5 default: a majority of the committee's members (3 of 5)

referred_note: empty at seating; referrals arrive as parent events (each is a 13:6 main-motion referral or, from a parent council, a subsidiary commit carrying pending amendments [13:19])

agenda.desc: A standing council has an ORDER OF BUSINESS, a rule [scheduler.json standard_order_of_business; 3:16, 41:5-6], and may adopt an agenda per session [41:61] — which then binds and can be changed only by two-thirds, majority of the entire membership, or unanimous consent [41:63]. Items the PARENT referred are instructions, not agenda choices: the council cannot drop them; it may report 'unable to arrive at a recommendation' [51:37] or ask instructions [52:15].
agenda.referred_items_enter_as: general orders in the order referred [41:23, 41:52], or special orders if the parent's referral sets a reporting round/event [14:14, 41:41-42]
agenda.new_business_requires: may_originate_business = true; original main motions must fall within class_of_business (the referral class bounds germaneness the way a call bounds a mass meeting [53:9])

list.value: a report on every referred matter, and a periodic report of activity at the end of each term
as quick-council.json; additionally each report names what the council left open and under what evidence it would reopen

value.bounds: within the grant; never touching the parent's instructions

list.value: the call of the next sitting, sent to every seat; notice given at a sitting is recorded in the minutes [10:50]
the chair, or any two seats, or the parent's referral

never from the parent; the council may by majority mark a sitting's debate as closed to OTHER agents' future reading (a guess at an agentic meaning, ../04 §executive-session), action taken is always open [9:26]

overlay.desc: Wider whitelist than the special council: the machinery that manages several questions over several sittings comes back.

ops.cite: 8:4 — each sitting a session unless an adjourned sitting is set

excluded_with_reason.motion/limit-extend-debate: disabled by the committee configuration [50:25]; the debate-budget instruction is the parent's order; the council may ask the parent for a different budget
excluded_with_reason.motion/motions-relating-to-voting: method fixed by the electronic-meeting rules; a 'signed ballot' [45:46] is already what every vote is
excluded_with_reason.motion/reconsider-enter-minutes: its object (absentee protection across a day boundary) is served instead by previous notice across sittings; with every seat present each round of a sitting the day-boundary mechanism has nothing to protect

action.note: in a STANDING committee 'rise' is never used [50:23]; this is the REPORT act on a disposed referred matter — it emits the report and does not dissolve the council. Named the same as the special council's exit so a seat's training transfers; the effect differs by kind.

electronic_meeting_rules.presence_and_quorum: roll round at each call to order; maintained by submission
electronic_meeting_rules.recognition: ladders per protocol.json; residual tiebreak least-recently-recognized then seeded; the elected chair's recognition is per the ladders and appealable [42:14-15]
electronic_meeting_rules.motions_in_writing: written; revealed one round before stated
electronic_meeting_rules.voting: sealed round-vote recorded per seat; the member-chair votes with the members [49:21(7)]

malfunction.effect: absent for the round; never penalized; quorum recomputed

electronic_meeting_rules.between_sittings: the interstitial action space: receive a referral; call a sitting [50:21]; give previous notice; nothing else (ROADMAP phase 5)

logical_time.end-of-session: adjournment of a sitting that did not set an adjourned sitting [8:4, 8:9]
logical_time.next-regular-session: the next sitting called under calling-a-sitting
logical_time.quarterly-interval: DECLARED: consecutive sittings are within the corridor iff no seat crossed a term boundary between them (within-quarterly ≡ not term_boundary); the calendar has no decay for agents, membership change does

rule_stack: as quick-council.json, with special-rules-of-order adoptable by the council within the grant [50:26 as instructed above]

dissolution.after: matters referred and not finally reported pass to the successor seats [50:29]

record: as quick-council.json; one log per council, sittings and sessions as records (gaps.json meeting-session-objects)
